Hi Dev,

Thanks again for the quick demo earlier. The team here would like a 60–75 minute onboarding session that covers: a console walkthrough, API key provisioning, and a short live example of generating clinical note summaries. We have a few people who should attend (product, IT, and one ML engineer).

Proposed windows (PST):
- Tue, Aug 24 — 10:00–11:15
- Wed, Aug 25 — 13:00–14:15
- Thu, Aug 26 — 08:30–09:45

Can you confirm availability and whether you prefer morning vs afternoon? Also, is there anything we should prepare in advance (IP allowlists, test data, account info)?

Best,
Clara
Clara Zhou
Head of Clinical Product, Novus Health
clara@novushealth.ai
From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>

Date: Wed, 19 Aug 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Console & API Intro — pick preferred slot

Hi Clara — thanks, those windows work. Quick notes from our side:

Agenda (60–75m) — draft
- 0–10m: Introductions + goals
- 10–30m: Redwood Console walkthrough (projects, keys, usage insights)
- 30–50m: API demo (key creation, simple generate call, embeddings)
- 50–65m: Live clinical note summary example + Q&A
- 65–75m: Next steps / action items

Availability: Monica and I can take Tue 10:00–11:15 (PST) or Wed 13:00–14:15 (PST). Marissa (solutions engineer) is available Wed afternoon and Thu morning.

Prep for you:
- Please share one short (de-identified) sample note for the demo if comfortable. Otherwise we can use our synthetic sample.
- If your security team requires IP allowlisting for sandbox keys, please send the CSIRT contact. We can also provide a short script to create a temporary API key during the session.

I’ll loop in Marissa for the live demo work. Would you prefer Tue at 10 or Wed at 13?

Thanks,
Dev
Dev Patel
Sr. Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>

Hi Clara — quick note from me: I’ll be co-presenting the console walkthrough and can cover basic billing/usage dashboards and rollout tips. Marissa will run the live API demo and validate any network setup before the session. If you confirm Wed 13:00–14:15 PST, I’ll reserve that slot on our calendar.

Also, Clara — do you want us to include a 10m segment on model selection and quantization tradeoffs for cost-sensitive workloads? If not, we’ll skip it to keep the session tight.

Cheers,
Monica
From: Clara Zhou <clara@novushealth.ai>

Thanks all — Wed 13:00–14:15 PST works best for our team. Please include the model-selection segment (we’re evaluating cost vs. accuracy tradeoffs).

Prep answers:
- We’ll share a de-identified sample note by EOD Monday.
- IT will likely ask for an allowlist; contact is it@novushealth.ai (cc’d).
- Attendees: myself, Rahul (product), Leila (ML eng), and our security lead Sam (IT).

Can you send a calendar invite and the agenda + any short pre-reqs? Looking forward to it.

— Clara

See you Wed — Dev
